proof: Use the $n-1$ domain points $A_k=\{1,\ldots,k\}$, ordered as $A_{n-1},A_{n-2},\ldots,A_1$. The traces of $u_n,u_{n-1},\ldots,u_1$ are respectively the empty trace and the successive initial segments, giving a threshold witness of dimension n-1. Conversely, a threshold witness of dimension d contains d+1 distinct traces and therefore needs d+1 distinct hypotheses; since $|\mathcal U_n|=n$, d\leq n-1.
name: Threshold Dimension of Universal Class
